basis: Repository code search finds SourceRelationResolver production ownership in rawlsing_next/pre553_source_relations.py.

source_chain: F7 authenticates only the outer entry by calling SourceRelationResolver.decide(resolver, ...).
_validate_positive consults caller-held self._registry and calls its resolve_exact virtually.

exact_instance_mutability.consequence: type(resolver) is SourceRelationResolver does not stop caller-side post-construction method/state replacement.

blocker_1.concrete_attack: Construct an exact SourceRelationResolver with no registered relation, then attach an instance-side resolve_exact that returns an otherwise lawful positive relation. F7's non-virtual base decide still executes, but its self.resolve_exact lookup reaches the injected instance method and can authorize material absent from the constructor-validated relation set.
stronger_variants: mutate _by_ref/_by_key directly because they remain ordinary mutable dictionaries
blocker_1.threat_model_fit: HQ225 itself treats caller-side concrete.decide replacement as in-scope. The same exact-instance mutability cannot become trusted merely because the replaced method is one frame deeper.

source_chain: SourceRelationResolver.__init__ accepts isinstance(authority_registry, AuthorityRegistry), not exact type.
_validate_positive obtains the relation-authorizing snapshot through self._registry.resolve_exact(authority) using virtual instance dispatch.
F7 later resolves an independent outer SOURCE_EQUIVALENCE snapshot and cross-binds only AuthorityRef identity.
blocker_2.consequence: An AuthorityRegistry subclass nested inside an exact resolver may return different/widened snapshot semantics under the same AuthorityRef identity. The outer A/B equality check proves ref equality, not that internal owner validation consumed the exact outer snapshot at full SourceUniverseRelation/scope grain.

repair_ceiling: Bind/freeze the complete adopted-owner lookup and validation path; do not add relation kinds, authority kinds, semantic states, or new downstream power.
